Online selling or paid bookings, with the booking system included

Payments and order emails

addOn.name: Growth plan
addOn.title: Want more traffic and enquiries?
addOn.text: Add the Growth plan: SEO, GEO and AEO optimisation, four blog posts and two email campaigns every month.

note: Every build ships with search built in. Staying found is ongoing work (reviews, Google posts, blog posts and reports), and that’s what the monthly plans do: Local keeps you found nearby, and Growth adds SEO, GEO and AEO content every month.
Every site is tested on Google’s own speed test before launch. Shopify stores are built for speed.
Timelines run from your start date, once we have your content.
Projects are booked into our schedule in the order deposits arrive. We confirm your start date once your deposit clears.

Every website is built in our own code, never WordPress or Squarespace templates. Most online shops are built on Shopify, the world’s leading e-commerce platform, with a custom design for your brand. If you already take card payments another way, we can build the shop in our own code around it.

addOn.name: AI Voice Receptionist
addOn.title: Never miss another call?
addOn.text: Add the AI Voice Receptionist: it answers missed and out-of-hours calls. On a 12-month agreement.

note: Every client chooses before the build starts: a monthly plan, or a handover.
Not included on any plan: ad spend or ad management, new pages, new features or design changes.
Shopify stores are hosted by Shopify, so they don’t need Care. They start on Growth, and Scale adds automated abandoned-basket, win-back and launch emails and texts.
Need something specific? If your business needs something these plans don’t cover, we’ll scope a monthly plan around it, with its own deliverables, fee and terms agreed in writing.
